source: prod session 0aa3a650 (2026-09-19), @IDAIRL, gemini-3.1-flash-lite — the failing run: turn 1 joined booking_segment_id = ffp_member_id, turn 2 took 7 LLM rounds / 4 SQL and paired names positionally
notes: agent_calls are the RECORDED (wrong) SQL — the bench replays the conversation as it happened and measures the enrichment against what a correct answer needs

turns.query: What are my top 5 customers based on miles flown

arguments.sql:
SELECT TOP 5
    M.ffp_member_id,
    SUM(A.base_miles) AS TotalBaseMiles
FROM airlines_core.mileage_accrual A
JOIN airlines_core.ffp_member M ON A.booking_segment_id = M.ffp_member_id
GROUP BY M.ffp_member_id
ORDER BY TotalBaseMiles DESC

turns.query: Give me the names of those customers

arguments.sql:
SELECT TOP 5 B.ffp_member_id, C.customer_name, SUM(B.miles_flown) AS total_miles
FROM airlines_core.boarding_event B
JOIN airlines_core.accounts_receivable C ON B.ffp_member_id = C.customer_account_number
GROUP BY B.ffp_member_id, C.customer_name
ORDER BY total_miles DESC

SELECT TOP 5 B.ffp_member_id, C.customer_name, SUM(B.boarding_event_id) AS total_events
FROM airlines_core.boarding_event B
JOIN airlines_core.accounts_receivable C ON B.ffp_member_id = CAST(C.customer_account_number AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY B.ffp_member_id, C.customer_name
ORDER BY total_events DESC
SELECT TOP 5 customer_account_number, customer_name FROM airlines_core.accounts_receivable
